text: The 2024 transform resolved keyed fields and disabled its ESR bump path. That transform no longer exists at the fixed accepted revision. Current release-version-bump uses the Lando transform and bumps version_display.txt by default; release and esr.* bump both version.txt and version_display.txt. Preserve the current release-type mapping. Do not carry the historical ESR-disabled rule forward.
title: Keep the beta version-bump file list separate from release and ESR
